purpose: Create stable business-neutral applications, registered relative routes, navigation entries, enablement state, permission references, and idempotency receipts.
lockImpact: Creates a new module-owned schema, tables, constraints, and indexes only; no existing table is rewritten or locked.
dataImpact: Creates empty registry structures. No internal route, external route, role, permission grant, CRM application, or navigation item is seeded.
backfill: Not required. Registrations are accepted only through explicit authorized commands.
recovery: Roll back the application while retaining registered stable identifiers. Restore the pre-migration point only before registrations are accepted.
forwardFix: This unmerged migration may be corrected during its pre-G2 review. After first application, append a reviewed app-registry-owned migration for constraints or schema repairs and never rewrite the applied migration.
